[get_weather]
get_weather({"city":"San Francisco"}) => WEATHER_CONDITION=SUNNY CITY=San Francisco

[geocode]
geocode({"place":"Golden Gate Bridge"}) => PLACE=Golden Gate Bridge LAT=37.8199 LON=-122.4783
geocode({"place":"Ferry Building"}) => PLACE=Ferry Building LAT=37.7955 LON=-122.3937

[route_time]
route_time({"destination_lat":37.7955,"destination_lon":-122.3937,"origin_lat":37.8199,"origin_lon":-122.4783}) => ROUTE_MINUTES=24 MODE=drive (24 minutes)
